    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    new_remaining = bins - item
    valid_new_remaining = np.where(new_remaining < 0, np.inf, new_remaining)
    target_remaining_ratio = 0.2
    target_remaining = target_remaining_ratio * bins
    deviation = np.abs(valid_new_remaining - target_remaining)
    priority_scores = 1.0 / (deviation + 1e-9)
    priority_scores = np.where(new_remaining < 0, -np.inf, priority_scores)
    return priority_scores
